target_customer: Finance, IT and procurement teams at mid-size and larger companies that buy software and manage vendors
problem: Buying software is slow and fragmented, and organizations lack control over the purchasing process and the vendor lifecycle that follows.
business_model: B2B SaaS marketplace and workflow platform for software procurement; later vendor lifecycle and third-party risk management
product_category: Software procurement marketplace, later vendor lifecycle and third-party risk AI platform

founders.name: Harikrishna Narayanan
prior_employers: Workday (director, Machine Learning Services product and engineering)
education: Georgia Institute of Technology, MS Computer Science

founders.name: Srikanth Veeraraghavan
prior_employers: PlanGrid (Head of Security, Privacy and Compliance)
education: Johns Hopkins University, MS Information Security
Vellore Institute of Technology, India, BTech Information Technology
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Security and privacy specialist.

competitors.name: Vendr
competitors.what: SaaS buying platform that negotiated software purchases on behalf of companies
competitors.traction_then: YC Summer 2019 company; traction at the time not found

technical_complexity.rationale: A marketplace plus workflow and integrations with ERP and procurement systems is standard engineering. The founders had machine learning experience from Workday, but the 2020 product did not need research-grade work.

defensibility.rationale: Procurement workflows create some lock-in once vendor and contract data live in the tool, but a marketplace for buying software had no network effect or proprietary data at launch.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it in a way found by sources. Expent was acquired in October 2025 by Hyperproof, a governance, risk and compliance platform, after shifting toward vendor risk.

market_need_then: Companies were adding many SaaS tools and the purchase, renewal and security review process was manual and spread across teams. Evidence is the founders' own framing on the YC page; no independent demand data was collected.

branding.domain_note: Used expent.ai; the domain now redirects to Hyperproof following the acquisition.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community material about the brand itself was found; the brand was folded into Hyperproof.

pivots.to: Vendor lifecycle management and third-party risk management
pivots.why: Search coverage and Hyperproof describe Expent as an AI platform for vendor lifecycle and third-party risk by the time of the acquisition; the date of the shift is not sourced.

outcome_analysis: Expent started as a software procurement marketplace in the YC Winter 2021 batch with two technical founders from Workday and PlanGrid. Public funding data is thin, with only unverified aggregator figures of roughly 125 to 130 thousand dollars, which suggests a capital efficient path. The company moved toward vendor lifecycle and third-party risk management and was acquired by Hyperproof in October 2025 on undisclosed terms, so the result is a modest exit rather than a venture scale outcome.
notes: Funding: aggregators cite about 125K to 130K dollars in one round; seen only in aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. The acquisition date of October 7, 2025 comes from search result coverage and the YC page news link; the Hyperproof page shows only an updated date of March 2026 and gives no terms. Competition: Tropic and other tools appear in later alternatives lists with no date near 2021, so they are not listed. Founders' prior employers and education come from the YC page.
